description: Android playback diagnostics preview for Spotify 9.1.80.2221 ARM64 (APKM). Adds opt-in Playback identity and Shuffle probe: reads live shuffle/suppression flags and manually compares SetOptions vs SetShufflingContext. No Desktop spoof or Premium unlock. Existing audio ad patches remain unchanged. Experimental, untested on device. https://github.com/NasiGoRank/morphe-spicetify-patches/tree/experiment/desktop-capability-shuffle-probe
